scope: Actual trained8B weights; independent per-token symmetric activation/native per-head KV4 protocol; no Table1 equivalence claim

timing.mode: eager synchronized wall time; no CUDA Graph claim
timing.logits: last position only, matched across all Stage A rows
timing.cache: all pages/scales/length/init flags cleared; decode prefix rebuilt before every repetition

quantization.weights: released BF16 base cast to FP16
quantization.table1_difference: Table1 uses asymmetric group128 activations and KIVI token-axis grouped K plus residual32

checkpoint_loading.dtype: original BF16 checkpoint converted to FP16 for this backend

component_profile.scope: independent diagnostic pass after main timing
component_profile.interpretation: inclusive, non-additive; does not partition end-to-end wall latency

categories.act_quant_pack: native per-token quantizer including INT4 packing
categories.linear: Linear4bit CUTLASS+dequant or FP16 Linear; R2 post-hook excluded
categories.r4: actual full original E14 online R4 including signs/permutation/Hadamard/WY
categories.kv_cache_update: native packed write, metadata and prefill unpack/inverse-H128
